records.title: 500geek list.txt
records.provenance: Exact founder-upload bytes and original filename, UTF-8/CRLF preserved. No matching tracked blob in HQ at 65820b08a8b84d08db1756a65c2e9bf83df66569 or the pinned founding-document tree index. Extracted 500 ordered entries in ten groups, 482 distinct exact names and 18 repeated-name pairs. Different from the current generated collection; no edition mapping or creation-time certification.
records.rights: Founder-supplied project planning text. Named third-party brands/themes are historical concepts, not licensed artwork or endorsement.
